value: On-rails bullet hell inside a giantess body.

The Hero Ash confronts Demon Lord Gabriella after she stole a huge amount of candy from the kingdom.
Using magic, she grows to an enormous size and swallows him whole. Noticing that monsters inside her body are causing her discomfort, the Hero and Demon Lord agree to co-operate as he fights them off.

On-rails bullet hell sequences inside a girl's body. 
Depending on which part of the body you are in, pressing X will have various effects on the level as she drinks water, holds her breath, etc.
